observations.measurement_context: (2) Thickness of Coated Layer When a coated layer was formed on a surface of a microporous film, thickness of the coated layer was calculated by difference between the thicknesses of the microporous film before and after coating. In case of coating on both sides, thickness of the coated layer was half (½) of the difference between the thicknesses before and after coating. If necessary, cross-section was cut by microtoming (or cryotoming), and the cross-section was observed by means of an electron microscopy to measure the thickness.
observations.notes: Publication US20120077113A1; Example; printed unit: μm. Example identity and experimental protocol retained; no processing temperature inferred.
